name: add_double_precision_values
description: Adds two packed double-precision values by unpacking sign, exponent and mantissa, aligning the smaller operand and combining the mantissas. A zero operand returns the other value, and the normalised result is stored at the first operand's address.

name: align_and_add_mantissas
description: Shifts the smaller mantissa by the exponent difference, then adds or subtracts the two mantissas with sign handling and renormalises them. The packed result goes to the target double through the shared finishing routines.

name: pack_negative_double_result
description: Negates a mantissa pair and packs it as a double with the sign bit forced on when the exponent is positive. Otherwise it stores zero.

name: shift_align_and_add_mantissas
description: Shifts a low-order mantissa right one bit at a time by a count, adds it to the other mantissa, renormalises the sum and stores the packed double, or zero when the exponent is out of range.

name: normalise_subtract_and_pack
description: Subtracts one mantissa from the other, shifts the difference left or right until it is normalised, and stores a packed double with the sign bit set. A non-positive exponent stores zero, or all-ones for a very large negative exponent.

name: shift_subtract_divide_bits
description: Builds quotient bits by repeatedly comparing a remainder with a divisor and shifting, then stores the packed result. Out-of-range exponents store zero or a saturated value.

name: pack_double_result
description: Stores the assembled double at the target address when the exponent is positive. It saturates to a signed maximum for a very large negative exponent and otherwise stores zero. Most arithmetic routines branch here to finish.

name: store_zero_double
description: Writes zero to both longwords of the destination double and returns the stacked result.

name: store_signed_max_or_zero
description: Stores a signed maximum double when the exponent falls below the lower bound, and zero otherwise. It is the underflow and overflow finishing step after an arithmetic operation.

name: multiply_double_precision_values
description: Multiplies two double-precision values by splitting the mantissas into 16-bit parts and accumulating the partial products. It then adds the exponents, sets the sign from both operands, normalises the product and stores it, or zero when the exponent is out of range.

name: store_zero_double
description: Writes zero to both longwords of the destination double and returns the stacked result.

name: store_signed_max_or_zero
description: Stores a signed maximum double when the exponent falls below the lower bound, and zero otherwise. It is the underflow and overflow finishing step after an arithmetic operation.

name: divide_double_precision_values
description: Divides one double-precision value by another by shift-and-subtract mantissa division, combining exponents and signs and storing the packed quotient. A zero divisor stores a signed maximum, and out-of-range results saturate or go to zero.

name: build_division_quotient_bits
description: Runs the quotient-bit loop of a double divide, rounds the mantissa and normalises it. It then stores the packed quotient, or zero or a saturated value when the exponent is out of range.

name: round_and_pack_quotient
description: Rounds and normalises the quotient mantissa and stores a packed double with its sign. Out-of-range exponents store zero or a saturated value.

name: store_zero_double
description: Writes zero to both longwords of the destination double and returns the stacked result.

name: store_signed_max_double
description: Stores a signed maximum double with the sign taken from the first operand register. It is the result used for divide-by-zero and overflow.

name: store_signed_max_or_zero
description: Stores a signed maximum double when the exponent falls below the lower bound, and zero otherwise. It is the underflow and overflow finishing step after an arithmetic operation.

name: flip_double_sign_bit
description: Flips the sign bit of the double at the pointer in the data register, unless its exponent field is zero, so a zero stays unsigned.

name: pass_through_stack_argument
description: The decompiled body only returns the 32-bit value passed on the stack, and no comparison logic is visible in this pseudo-code. It exits with that argument unchanged.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the 32-bit value passed on the stack without changing it. Other double-precision routines branch here as their common exit.

name: open_requester_libraries_and_state
description: Opens the libraries and console device the requester needs and allocates a 196-byte state block, copied from a template. If any step fails it releases what it has already opened and returns.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns at once with no library calls or memory writes, so it is an empty entry point.

name: call_vector_then_return_zero
description: Makes one library call through a fixed vector, then returns zero.

name: call_vector_then_return_zero
description: Makes one library call through a fixed vector, then returns zero.

name: call_vector_then_return_zero
description: Makes one library call through a fixed vector, then returns zero.

name: close_libraries_and_free_state
description: Closes each opened library handle and the device handle when they are set, then frees the state memory and its buffer.

name: increment_counter_clear_flag
description: Adds one to the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the requester structure and clears bit 3 of the flags byte at offset 14. It makes no library calls.

name: decrement_counter_and_finish
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32. When it reaches zero and flag bit 3 at offset 14 is set, it calls the follow-on routine and returns its result, otherwise zero.

name: finish_or_mark_pending
description: If the counter at offset 32 is zero, it passes the value stored at offset 50 to a library vector and returns that result. Otherwise it sets flag bit 3 to mark a pending finish and returns zero.

name: call_vector_return_stored_value
description: Calls a library vector and then returns the 32-bit value stored at offset 50 of the same structure.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero, so it is an empty handler entry.

name: forward_then_return_argument
description: Calls a follow-on routine, then returns the 32-bit value that was in the first data register on entry.

name: clamp_rectangle_to_bounds
description: Clamps the position and size words of a rectangle to the limits given on the stack, then returns 1 when the rectangle fits inside those limits and 0 otherwise.

name: divide_scaled_words
description: Computes a 16-bit quotient of two values after scaling them to fit, and returns minus one for a zero divisor.

name: divide_after_shifting_down
description: Shifts a 48-bit numerator and its divisor right together until the divisor fits in 16 bits, then returns the quotient.

name: return_minus_one_result
description: Returns a result word of minus one, with the stacked argument as the low word.

name: divide_scaled_minus_one
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a scaled 16-bit difference, shifting both to fit, and returns the quotient minus one. A zero numerator returns zero.

name: shift_divide_minus_one
description: Shifts the numerator and divisor right together until the divisor fits in 16 bits, then returns the 16-bit quotient minus one.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero, so it is an empty handler entry.

name: multiply_word_by_difference
description: Multiplies a 16-bit factor by the difference of two 32-bit words, applies carry correction, and returns the high-order part.

name: run_requester_event_loop
description: Lays out the requester window and its text from the supplied strings, then waits on the window's message port. It returns a gadget result or a code for the keys n, q, b, l, y, v, r or m, and it closes the dialog when the loop ends.

name: run_requester_text_loop
description: Copies the prompt text into a buffer, sizes and places the requester window, and sets up its gadget block when the geometry values are non-zero. It then polls the message port and returns a result code from gadget clicks or the same key set.

name: run_requester_with_signal
description: Allocates a signal for the requester, sets up its window and gadgets, then polls the message port for gadget clicks and keys. It frees the signal and window memory before it returns.

name: run_requester_timed_wait
description: Opens a timer port for the requester, starts a timed request, and polls the window port for gadget clicks, keys and timer completion. It returns a result code and releases its resources before it returns.

name: poll_requester_messages
description: Waits on the window's message port, takes each queued message, and returns a result from a gadget click or a matching key. It exits when the close flag or the escape key is seen.

name: wait_for_requester_input
description: Loops on the window port, reading each message and returning the gadget identifier for a gadget-up event or a result code from a matching key. Otherwise it keeps waiting.

name: read_requester_key_result
description: Reads queued input messages and maps the typed keys to result codes, returning as soon as a matching key or a gadget identifier is found.

name: release_requester_timer_resources
description: Aborts any pending timer request, waits for it, closes the timer device, removes the port, and frees its signal and memory.

name: draw_requester_text_items
description: Walks a null-terminated list of text items and draws each one through a rendering call, advancing until the terminating zero byte.

name: find_longest_string_width
description: Scans a list of text items and returns the largest width reported for them, stopping at the zero terminator.

name: count_characters_to_newline
description: Counts characters in a string up to a newline or the terminating zero and returns that count.

name: multiply_two_word_results
description: Calls two routines that each return a 16-bit value and returns their product.

name: init_requester_gadget_box
description: Writes the position, flags and text pointer fields of a gadget structure from the supplied coordinates, then links it to the next gadget in the list.

name: init_rectangle_structure
description: Zeroes a four-word rectangle structure and sets its width and height from the two data-register arguments.

name: init_requester_text_item
description: Sets the position, draw mode and text pointer fields of a text item from the supplied coordinates and links it into the list.

name: format_message_return_zero
description: Formats a message through the system formatter using the arguments the caller prepared, then returns zero.

name: store_byte_if_pointer_set
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address in the address register when that pointer is non-null, and does nothing otherwise.

name: read_process_task_value
description: Looks up the current task, and if it is a process returns the positive 32-bit field at offset 184 from it. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: init_requester_window_frame
description: Stores the position, size and title fields into a requester structure, then initialises its gadget and border lists through two follow-on routines.

name: init_requester_gadget_item
description: Sets the gadget type, flags and limit fields of a requester item and links it to the following item in the list.

name: build_requester_window_layout
description: Allocates a requester structure, copies the caller's title and geometry into it, sizes the window from its text and gadget widths, and sets up its message port and border list.

name: build_number_entry_requester
description: Allocates a requester for numeric input, sets its geometry and gadget widths from the caller's values, and sets up the prompt "Get a number" with its message port and gadget list.

name: run_text_entry_requester
description: Opens a text-entry requester with the prompt "Get some text" and Ok and Cancel gadgets, then waits for input. The entered string is copied back when Ok is chosen, and the window is closed afterwards.

name: flag_out_of_range_entry
description: Checks an entered value against its minimum and maximum. When it is out of range, it shows "Too large!" or "Too small!" and sounds the display beep.

name: close_window_and_menu
description: Clears the menu strip and closes the requester window, then frees its two memory blocks.

name: draw_requester_box_outline
description: Moves the drawing position and draws four lines with the rendering library to outline a box in the window's rastport.

name: init_requester_gadget_frame
description: Sets the flags and position fields of a gadget pair from the flag bits and coordinates, then passes the state through a library call.

name: init_gadget_from_stack_args
description: Sets the flags and position fields of a gadget pair from stacked arguments, applying a fixed offset and width, then returns.

name: adjust_gadget_position
description: Shifts a gadget's position and width by the supplied deltas and marks it highlighted when flag 64 is set.

name: select_requester_font_height
description: Looks up the requester's text font. If it exists it sets that font and returns its height, otherwise it returns a default height.

name: forward_to_follow_on_routine
description: Calls a follow-on routine and returns nothing.

name: get_selection_value_pair
description: Reads the 16-bit value and its companion word from the requester's current selection record. It returns a default pair when no record is set.

name: read_selection_word_pair
description: Returns two words from a selection record: the value at offset 20 and the companion at offset 24.

name: push_node_onto_list
description: Pushes a node onto a singly linked list by storing the current head in the node and making the node the new head.

name: push_node_onto_list
description: Pushes a node onto a singly linked list by storing the current head in the node and making the node the new head.

name: push_node_with_position
description: Pushes a node onto a singly linked list, storing its two position words at offsets 4 and 6 before linking it in.

name: submit_zeroed_text_request
description: Zeroes a ten-word local block, sets a flag and the requested value, then submits it through a library call.

name: retry_requester_step_sequence
description: Makes a library call and, if it fails, runs six follow-on steps before trying again. It gives up after three attempts.

name: wait_frame_until_ready
description: Waits for the next display frame and runs six follow-on steps between attempts, stopping once a library call reports success or the count runs out.

name: forward_to_follow_on_routine
description: Calls a follow-on routine and returns nothing.

name: draw_text_with_pen
description: Moves the drawing position, sets the pen colour, then draws the text through the rendering library.

name: strip_last_path_component
description: Trims the last element from the path in the file name buffer at offset 1292, stopping at a colon or at the start of the path.

name: clear_flag_and_call_handler
description: If the flag at offset 1672 is set, clears it and calls the handler stored in the structure at offset 364.

name: clear_flag_and_call_library
description: If the flag at offset 1672 is set, clears it and calls a library vector through the stored base.

name: free_linked_node_list
description: Walks a linked list, unlinking each node and returning its memory with the memory-free call until the list ends.

name: return_stack_value_pair
description: Returns the 64-bit value passed on the stack unchanged.

name: init_list_head_node
description: Initialises a list header by calling three follow-on routines, then pointing its tail back at itself and clearing its first word.

name: run_four_setup_steps
description: Calls four follow-on routines in order and then returns.

name: free_stored_buffer
description: Clears the buffer pointer at offset 344 and frees that buffer with the memory-free call when it was set.

name: call_stored_library_vector
description: Calls a library vector through the library pointer stored at offset 368.

name: call_stored_window_vector
description: Calls a window library vector through the pointer stored at offset 368.

name: call_two_stored_routines
description: Calls two library routines in sequence through the pointer stored at offset 372.

name: fill_entry_list_fields
description: Clears three counters, then loops over entries returned by library calls, copying their position words and name into the structure until no entry remains.

name: scan_directory_entries
description: Reads directory entries one at a time, copying each name and its size and date fields into the requester buffers, and stops when no further entry is returned.

name: show_directory_read_error
description: Draws the message "Couldn't read directory." in the requester window through the rendering library, after setting the pen and position.

name: call_window_vector_if_clear
description: When flag bit 32 at offset 36 is clear, calls a window library vector through the stored pointer. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: retry_text_render_sequence
description: Tries a text rendering library call up to three times, running six follow-on steps between attempts, and stops as soon as the call succeeds.

name: retry_selected_render_sequence
description: Chooses one of two text blocks from the flags, then tries the render call up to three times with six follow-on steps between attempts.

name: retry_alternate_render_sequence
description: Chooses between two text blocks from the flags, then tries the render call up to three times with six follow-on steps between attempts.

name: retry_secondary_render_sequence
description: Chooses a second text block from the flags, then tries the render call up to three times with six follow-on steps between attempts.

name: draw_rectangle_frame
description: Passes four coordinate values to a rendering call, then makes four follow-on drawing calls to outline a rectangle.

name: draw_padded_frame_rect
description: Draws a rectangle outline padded by two units horizontally and one vertically, using the same four follow-on drawing calls.

name: format_number_as_decimal
description: Writes a 32-bit number as decimal ASCII digits backwards into a buffer, one digit per division by ten, ending at the buffer position supplied by the caller.

name: draw_list_item_row
description: Copies a list entry's name into a row buffer, pads it with spaces to the column width, adds a size or directory marker, and draws the row.

name: build_list_row_entry
description: Builds one list row from an entry's name padded to the column width with a size or directory marker. It also removes the entry from the list when it is the selected one.

name: pad_row_with_blanks
description: Pads a list row with spaces up to the column width and writes the directory marker when the entry is a directory, then draws the row.

name: finish_list_row_draw
description: Writes a trailing space into the row buffer and draws the finished row through two library calls.

name: find_list_entry_index
description: Walks a linked list from the head stored at offset 28 and returns the zero-based index of the given node, or minus one when it is not in the list.

name: count_nodes_until_match
description: Walks a linked list from a head pointer, counting nodes until it reaches the target node. It returns that count, or minus one when the list ends first.

name: draw_list_row_if_visible
description: Works out the row number of an entry, and if that row is in the visible range it rebuilds the entry's padded name and draws it through the rendering library.

name: test_point_in_box
description: Returns 1 when the point stored at offsets 1652 and 1654 lies inside the bounds given in the data registers, and 0 otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero, so it is an empty handler entry.

name: call_stored_port_vector
description: Calls a library vector through the pointer stored at offset 368 and returns nothing.

name: join_path_components
description: Copies a base path into a buffer, adds a slash when it does not already end in a colon or slash, and then appends the second name.

name: collect_list_entries_from_events
description: Reads queued input messages and, for each matching event, allocates a new list entry, fills its fields and pads its text to the column width.

name: pad_and_link_list_entry
description: Fills a new list entry with blank padding up to its width, stores its position word, and links it onto the list head.

name: release_message_and_return
description: Calls one library routine to release the pending message, then returns.

name: handle_list_selection_input
description: Handles input on a file list: when the pointer is over the list it updates the selected entry, scrolls the view, copies the chosen name into the path buffers and updates the list gadget.

name: track_mouse_button_in_list
description: Loops over the list interaction, reading the CIA port register for the mouse button bit. While the button is held it refreshes the highlighted entry, and it returns once the button is released.

name: copy_current_name_to_path
description: Clears a flag byte and copies the name buffer at offset 2730 into the path buffer at offset 1292, then makes three follow-on calls.

name: update_list_selection_state
description: Updates the list selection state when the pointer is over an entry, copies the chosen name and refreshes the list gadget, following the same steps as the other list handler.

name: find_list_entry_and_select
description: Looks for the list entry matching a given pointer. When it is found it records the pointer's coordinates and commits the selection; otherwise it clears the current name.

name: store_pointer_position_in_node
description: Copies two 32-bit pointer position values into the node at offsets 16 and 20, then makes two follow-on calls.

name: commit_list_selection_state
description: Commits the list selection. When the zero flag is set it stores the pointer position in the list record, otherwise it refreshes the selected name and list gadget.

name: add_list_entry_from_name
description: Allocates a list entry, copies the source entry's name into it, and stores it in the first free slot of the list, up to the list's limit.

name: append_copied_list_entry
description: Allocates a list entry, copies the source entry's position and name into it, and links it into the list.

name: spin_countdown_16bit
description: Counts a 16-bit value down in a loop until it wraps past zero, as a short busy wait, and returns the original value.

name: spin_short_delay
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it wraps to minus one, giving a short busy wait.

name: copy_entry_name_and_draw
description: Draws the list entry through the rendering library and copies its name into the current name buffer, after checking the list for a match.

name: draw_listing_status_line
description: Chooses a status line such as "Done." or a count of fonts, drawers, shown and hidden entries, and draws it through the rendering library.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls a follow-on routine repeatedly until the 16-bit value it returns is zero, then makes one final follow-on call.

name: call_until_word_zero
description: Repeats a follow-on call until the word held in the data register reaches zero, then makes a final follow-on call.

name: unlink_last_list_node
description: Walks a linked list to its last node and clears the pointer that refers to it, removing that node from the list.

name: compare_entry_names_ignore_case
description: Compares two list entries: when their size fields match, it compares their names one character at a time without regard to case, stopping at the first difference or the end of both names.

name: merge_sorted_lists
description: Merges two sorted linked lists using a comparison routine, relinking nodes in order until one list is exhausted, then attaches the remainder.

name: insert_into_sorted_list
description: Inserts a node into a sorted linked list by walking the list and relinking the node at the position the comparison routine selects.

name: append_sorted_node_tail
description: Relinks the list tail to the node in the second register, walking forward through the list to the insertion point.

name: store_list_link_pointer
description: Stores the address of the new node in the list pointer slot, or in the value passed in the first register when that value is non-zero.

name: run_four_steps_if_nonempty
description: When the structure pointer is non-null and its first field is non-zero, it makes four follow-on calls. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: link_entry_if_unflagged
description: When the entry's counter is zero and flag bit 2 is clear, it stores an entry value, marks the entry, and links it into the pending chain.

name: flush_when_below_limit
description: Compares an entry counter with its limit and, when the counter is smaller, calls a library vector through the stored window pointer.

name: update_entry_count_and_flush
description: Works out the difference between two counters, clamps it at zero and stores it, then flushes through a library call when the counter is below its limit.

name: test_font_file_match
description: Decides whether an entry passes the font filter, returning 1 for a match and 0 otherwise, based on the sign of its size field, the flag bits and the listing mode.

name: test_info_file_match
description: Decides whether an entry passes the info-file filter, using the sign of its size field and the flag bits, and returns 1 for a match and 0 otherwise.

name: move_entries_between_lists
description: Walks a list of entries and moves each one onto the list head chosen by the flag, updating the two counters as it goes.

name: relink_entries_into_list
description: Moves entries from one list onto another in turn, then returns zero once the source list is empty.

name: reset_list_counters
description: Zeroes the entry counter and list head fields, then makes three follow-on calls.

name: create_named_list_entry
description: Allocates a list entry, copies the given name into it with its length and flags, links it onto the list, and flushes when the time since the last update exceeds a threshold.

name: link_entry_and_check_timer
description: Links an entry into the pending list and updates its count. When the time since the last tick passes a threshold, it makes the follow-on calls that flush the list.

name: check_elapsed_and_flush
description: Reads the current timer value, works out the time since the stored start, and when that exceeds a threshold makes two follow-on calls.

name: branch_on_library_result
description: Calls a library vector and runs three follow-on steps when it returns zero, or a single step otherwise.

name: forward_to_follow_on_routine
description: Calls a follow-on routine and returns nothing.

name: flush_pending_entry_count
description: When the leading text byte is empty, it updates the entry count and flushes through a library call once the count is past the limit. Otherwise it clears the byte and makes follow-on calls.

name: fill_directory_name_buffers
description: Clears a leading byte, then walks directory entries through library calls, copying each entry's name into the path and name buffers, and stops when no entry is returned.

name: toggle_info_file_visibility
description: Flips the show-info-files flag when its mode bit is set, and records the matching "Hide .info files" or "Show .info files" label for the menu entry.

name: dispatch_list_selection_mode
description: Dispatches on the list's selection mode field. One mode does nothing, another makes a follow-on call, and the third commits the selected entry to the path and status buffers.

name: commit_single_selection
description: When the selection count is exactly one, it clears the name flags, updates the path and status buffers from the selection, and makes the usual follow-on calls.

name: commit_empty_selection_state
description: When the selection count is zero or less, it clears the name flags, updates the path and status buffers, and makes the usual follow-on calls. Otherwise it returns its input unchanged.

name: store_row_and_repeat_call
description: Stores a row value from the list record, makes a follow-on call, then repeats a follow-on call until the returned word is zero.

name: select_row_if_flag_set
description: When the flag at offset 1672 is set, it stores the current row value, makes a follow-on call and saves the row values back into the record.

name: scroll_list_region
description: Calls a window library vector, then makes one follow-on call for each row in the given count.

name: save_list_scroll_state
description: Copies the current list scroll values into the list record and installs three handler entries in it.

name: copy_names_if_changed
description: Compares the current name and path buffers with their saved copies. When they differ it copies them across, then zeroes the list counters and makes three follow-on calls.

name: save_name_buffers_and_reset
description: Copies the path and name buffers into their saved slots, zeroes the list counters, and makes three follow-on calls.

name: scroll_list_by_steps
description: Steps the list position by the scroll amount, looping while the list is not at its end and calling the follow-on routines, then repaints the list.

name: scroll_list_one_step
description: Moves the list position by one step when the scroll condition holds, calling the follow-on routines and repainting the list afterwards.

name: scroll_list_by_count
description: Scrolls the list by the row count passed in the data register, stepping the position and calling the follow-on routines until it stops changing, then repaints.

name: dispatch_list_key_action
description: Dispatches a list action on the key-state bits of the current entry. Each case either runs a follow-on step or commits the selected name to the path and status buffers.

name: dispatch_list_count_action
description: Branches on a count value: non-positive counts commit the current selection to the path and status buffers, and other values run the matching follow-on steps.

name: dispatch_list_flag_action
description: Checks the list flag bits and the entry state, then either commits the selection to the path and status buffers or runs the follow-on steps.

name: select_list_region_and_redraw
description: Chooses the list region offset from the flag bits and pointer position, then calls the window library up to three times, running six follow-on steps between attempts.

name: commit_list_mode_selection
description: When the count is positive it dispatches on the mode bits and commits the chosen entry to the path and status buffers. Otherwise it returns with the flag state.

name: select_list_region_by_count
description: Chooses one of several list region offsets from a count and the mode flags, then redraws through the window library with up to three attempts.

name: select_list_region_by_flags
description: Chooses one of several list region offsets from the flag bits and count, then redraws through the window library with up to three attempts.

name: select_list_region_on_decrement
description: Decrements the count when it is positive. Otherwise it chooses a list region from the mode flags and redraws it through the window library with up to three attempts.

name: return_nothing_stub
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: build_volume_name_list
description: Walks a list of volume or device names, allocating a node for each one that does not match an existing entry, writes it with a trailing colon, and links the node in.

name: build_name_list_entries
description: Compares a name against the existing list entries and, when no match is found, allocates a new entry holding the name with a colon appended, then links it in.

name: add_colon_named_entries
description: Scans a name string and adds a colon-terminated copy to the list when no existing entry matches, linking each new node in turn.

name: append_colon_named_entries
description: Allocates list nodes for the remaining names in the source list, copies each name with a trailing colon, and links them in order.

name: compute_file_requester_layout
description: Works out the file requester's layout from its minimum sizes and text metrics, storing the widths and heights of the list, gadgets and border fields.

name: build_file_requester_gadgets
description: Creates the file requester gadgets labelled Ok!, Forget it, Get Dir, Parent and the Hide or Show .info files toggle, and lays them out in the window.

name: compute_list_window_layout
description: Recomputes the list window geometry from the stored dimensions and text metrics, setting the list height and the widths of its gadget columns.

name: compute_list_row_metrics
description: Works out the row metrics of the list from the font height and entry count, and stores them in the list record.

name: measure_list_rows_with_font
description: Measures the list rows against the font through a library call, and stores the resulting row count and widths in the list record.

name: store_list_row_refs
description: Copies two stored values from the entry into the list record, then makes two library calls to refresh the list.

name: build_font_requester_gadgets
description: Creates the font requester labels and gadgets, including Ok!, the show and hide entries and the font size fields, then makes the library calls that set them up.

name: build_font_size_requester
description: Builds the font size requester gadgets with the Font name and Size labels and an Ok gadget, then runs the layout calls.

name: reset_list_record_fields
description: Zeroes three list record fields and makes a follow-on call.

name: get_port_message
description: Takes the next message from a port with the message-get call, falling back to the free pool when none is queued, and returns its pointer or zero when there is none.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero, so it is an empty handler entry.

name: process_window_messages_rawkey
description: Loops over the window's message flags. Close-window ends the loop, raw key events go to a follow-on handler, and gadget events are dispatched to follow-on steps.

name: process_window_messages_close_flag
description: Loops over the window's message flags with the close-window check first. It handles the flagged events, then saves the list state before returning.

name: process_window_messages_rawkey_alt
description: Loops over the window's message flags, dispatching raw key events and gadget events to follow-on steps until a close event ends the loop.

name: process_window_messages_close_save
description: Loops over the window's message flags. A close event ends the loop and saves the list state, while gadget and key events go to follow-on steps.

name: process_window_messages_gadget_flags
description: Loops over the window's message flags, dispatching gadget-up and menu events to follow-on steps until a close event ends the loop.

name: process_window_messages_menu_flags
description: Loops over the window's message flags, dispatching menu and item events to follow-on steps until a close event ends the loop.

name: process_window_messages_timer
description: Loops over the window's message flags, handling the timer event and dispatching the remaining events to follow-on steps until a close event ends the loop.

name: process_window_messages_full
description: Loops over the window's message flags, dispatching gadget, key, menu and timer events to follow-on steps. A close event ends the loop and the list state is saved.
